assignment: Tokens and Types in Roman Urdu Tweets
source: simulated demo student (persona: struggling) run through the real platform

viva.summary: The student understands the overall purpose of the code and can predict its output correctly; explanations of sorting logic and modification are mostly accurate but lack some detail.

rubric.revise_next: Review tie‑breaking in the sort and consider using `isnumeric()` for clearer numeric‑token filtering.

questions.answer: It sorts the words by how many times they appear so we can show the most popular ones. I think it also helps put them in a special order.
questions.feedback: You correctly identified that the condition sorts by frequency and breaks ties alphabetically, but could explain the tie‑break part more clearly.
questions.prompt: What does the line `if combined[j][1] > combined[i][1] or (combined[j][1] == combined[i][1] and combined[j][0] < combined[i][0]):` achieve in your `top_words` function, and why is it necessary?

questions.answer: It returns an empty list because there are no words to count.
questions.feedback: Exactly right – an empty string yields no tokens, so the result is an empty list.

questions.answer: I would just add an if statement that checks if the string is numeric using the isalpha method. That way it only keeps the words and skips all the numbers.
questions.feedback: Using `isalpha()` will indeed skip pure numbers, though mentioning `isnumeric()` or `isdigit()` would be more precise.
questions.prompt: If we wanted `top_words` to ignore any token that is purely numeric (e.g., "123"), how would you modify your implementation to achieve this?

messages.body: Ustaad, mujhe lagta hai loop sahi hai lekin answer galat aa raha hai. Hint dein?

Aapka code indentation ki wajah se stop ho raha hai, isliye aapko koi result nahi mil raha. Pehle is error ko fix kar ke code ko run karein, phir dekhein functions ka output kaisa aata hai. Kya aap indentation ko theek kar ke dobara run kar sakte hain?
messages.hint: Python cares about exact indentation; the extra space before the second print makes the file invalid, so none of your functions run.
